### Video 1 — `affordance_drag_hover_shadows`

- The video loads the real D&D Beyond **Corvo Saggio** character sheet and later opens the Print Enhancer’s **Beyond Print** panel.
- The panel shows layout/output controls on the left and **Layer Management** on the right, including **Sections (22)** and **Shapes (1)**.
- Hovering over sheet regions visibly reveals small dark action controls. These appear in the first rail slot of hovered sections, including the upper statistics area, the **Hit Points/Current/Max/Temp** box, and the **Defenses/Conditions** area.
- The revealed controls remain visually separate from the red section borders. A row of three dark action buttons is repeatedly visible over the right-side section, and similar controls appear over other wrappers.
- The sheet is scrolled down to the large bordered background shape and further into the lower text sections, then returned to the upper sheet.
- A toast reading **“Shapes (Default) Hidden”** appears, and the large decorative background shape is subsequently absent, exposing the white sheet beneath.
- Red outlines and small red corner markers become visible on hovered or selected regions, including the right-side section and several upper statistics boxes.
- The video also shows the layer panel’s **Shapes** controls and the sheet’s wrapper borders.
- However, the sampled frames do **not** clearly show a completed wrapper being dragged to a new position, a click-versus-drag comparison, a custom drag ghost, a locked layer remaining stationary, or a clear before/after moved-section pair. The handle-specific “one handle,” unhittability, lock safety, and hue-isolation assertions therefore are **NOT-VISIBLE**.

### Video 2 — `drag_glow_layers`

- The video loads the same character sheet and opens the **Beyond Print** and **Layer Management** panels.
- The visible panel contains layout controls such as **Load**, **Reset to Default**, **Manage Clones**, **Add Shape**, **Manage Compact**, **AI Arrange**, **AI Settings**, **Print**, **Print settings**, and **Save to Browser**.
- The right panel lists **Sections (22)**, named section entries, and **Shapes (1)** with shape thumbnails and an **Add Shape** button.
- A notice says **“No saved layout yet — the default template is loaded.”**
- The sheet is shown in its default layout, including the upper statistics, portrait frame, skills list, defenses/conditions section, and actions table.
- Apart from the sheet scrolling vertically, no clearly visible wrapper-background pointer drag, action-bar exclusion, locked-layer interaction, hover/active glow transition, print-stripping result, or Layer Management minimize/restore interaction is shown in the sampled frames.

**This video’s specified interactions are NOT-VISIBLE.**

### Video 3 — `drag_ux_visual_capture`

- The video loads the character sheet and opens the same extension panel, again showing the left-side layout/output controls and the right-side **Layer Management** list.
- The sheet is repeatedly scrolled between the upper character-sheet area and the lower actions/text sections.
- The sheet retains the same default arrangement. The upper sections and the actions area remain in place throughout the sampled frames.
- The Layer Management panel remains open and visible.
- No custom mouse-drag ghost, committed pointer-drag state, source-restore/wrapper-move before-and-after pair, touch-pointer drag, gold alignment guides, zero-jump drop, locked-layer visual state, post-drop autosave toast, or origin-clamped drop is visibly captured.

**This video’s specified visual-capture interactions are NOT-VISIBLE.**

Overall, the extension panel and several hover/action affordances are visibly present in Video 1, and one shape-hiding result is shown there. Across the three videos, however, the full drag-and-drop contract is not visibly demonstrated: the custom drag behavior, lock safety, snapping/alignment guides, touch drag, autosave confirmation, and origin clamping are not visible.
